استطلعن (form X)
# اِسْتَطْلَعْنَ (istaṭlaʕna) /is.tatˤ.laʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
# اُسْتُطْلِعْنَ (ustuṭliʕna) /us.tutˤ.liʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
# اِسْتَطْلِعْنَ (istaṭliʕna) /is.tatˤ.liʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
